name: TN-06
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district (R+13 PVI) with an open seat
Huge fundraising and outside-spending edge for Republican Johnny Garrett
Democratic nominee Mike Croley is nearly unfunded ($35K raised)
model.rationale: This R+13 open seat has no polling and no expert ratings, but the fundamentals are lopsided: Garrett raised $2.4M with outside support while Croley raised $35K, and Polymarket prices the race at 94% Republican. I move modestly toward Safe R from the baseline, keeping uncertainty elevated for an open seat with no polling.
model.watch: A late surge of Democratic outside spending or a scandal involving Garrett could narrow the race, though the district lean makes an upset very unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: John Rose (R) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Tennessee's 6th District is a solidly Republican seat, and John Rose's retirement to run for governor does not change that. The Republican nominee, Johnny Garrett, has raised about $2.4 million and drawn outside support, while Democrat Mike Croley has raised only about $35,000 with almost no cash on hand. No independent candidates appear well funded.

There are no public polls and no expert ratings for this race, so the forecast leans on district fundamentals, the money gap, and prediction markets, which price Republican chances around 94 percent. The seat is rated Safe Republican, with some residual uncertainty because open seats without polling can surprise.
